metrics.layer_count_definition: Nondecreasing receiving-body/root support courses; not hanging-tip bottomZ or slicing layers.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.scope: Occupied8mm/4.8mm source sample andwhole-part palette projectedonto the same normalizedbody. Excludes studs,gaps,chamfers andsupports; realCGmustbeviewed separately.

front.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

side.interpretation: Descriptive projected geometry overlap/boundary distance; no aesthetic or mechanical pass threshold

painted_feature_region.interpretation: Nearest source palette labels on actual registered visible surfaces. Face pose, color regions and gaps influence this statistic; it does not declare likeness approval.

descriptive_pattern_metrics.region_definition: Tight reference-front bbox of all non-base colorcells plus5pixels; not automatic anatomical landmark detection.
descriptive_pattern_metrics.interpretation: Differences are descriptive. Morepieces are not a validated likeness percentage or mechanical completion.

front.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
front.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

three_quarter.framing_method: Actual native vertex projection, not empty bounding-box corners; center and screen-height normalization per model.
three_quarter.normalization_note: The four shapes occupy equal screen height; this image group is NOT a physical size comparison.

limitations_ja: 倍率は実部品数で、寸法倍率ではありません。比較1xは本人不在時の暫定前提です。
元3MFの実塗色面と左右面を参照し、全実部品を鏡対応へ改訂しています。初期C/1x基準の不対称は未変更の参考として別に表示します。
放射状分解は説明図。物理的に衝突せず分解できる保証ではありません。下からの順序は公称支持の検査で、保持力は未確認です。
元の本体内の実部品を一体の受け・根元へ再構成し、外付け/仮の組立支台を不要とする候補です。実CADの接触・挿入・断面・全荷重prefixを検査済みですが、現物保持力や印刷時サポート不要は未確認です。
左右対称化のため旧案の格子形状・配色を意図して変更した新revisionです。旧案の形・色が不変という証拠は転用していません。
limitations_en: The multiplier is actual physicalpiececount, not linearsize. The1xbaseline is a provisional creator assumption while the user was unavailable.
Original3MF painted surfaces and its intrinsic reflection plane guide this actual paired-part revision. InitialC/1x retain their known asymmetry as unchanged references.
Radial explosion is explanatory, not collision-free physical disassembly. Bottom-up order has nominal support checks, not verified retention.

Existing body material is joined into real seated internal supports, with no external or temporary assembly stands. Native contact/insertion/sections/all nominal load prefixes are checked; physical retention and slicer-support requirements remain unvalidated.
This distinct bilateral revision intentionally changes prior cell geometry and paint; old unchanged-shape/color claims are not reused.

assembly_support.method: Paired actual whole-color material roots and reused native footprint supports; intentional symmetric body/color changes are bound separately from their mechanical baseline

observations_ja: copilot-p300-symmetric-v3は実53,575部品・306型、固定分母17,873/目標53,619との差-44。旧公開案を上書きせず、左右対称化のため形状と配色を意図して変更した別revisionである。
実FreeCADの全53,575部品について鏡対応ID・単色・poseの完全bijection/involutionを確認。272の型/回転ペアは実BRepの両向きcut体積差が全て0。セル図や類似率だけを根拠にしていない。元と別展開の全nativeID/type/color/pose/stepも一致した。
実Blender正面・斜め・登録正面・放射分解の4CGと、正面から同倍率で切り出した左右眼を閲覧した。黄色い眼は同じ鏡映外形・幅・高さ・上下位置へ修正され、青い顔、ゴーグル青領域/紫枠、耳/側面も対称な実形状となっている。斜め画角の遠近差や照明による濃淡差は左右形状の差とは分離する。
保存native sceneから照明を除いた実材質ラベル画像も作成・閲覧した。左右眼は各10,426pixels、bounds77x148pxで鏡位置が一致し、眼mirror XOR=0、最大境界差0pixels、全silhouette XOR=0、全material XOR=0。1pixel許容を設定しているが、今回の実差は0である。
旧案の印刷姿勢回転約0.903度と初期Cの非対称な色量子化の伝播を診断し、原3MFの左右面と実塗色面を参照した。1x/FineC自体の微小な不対称を隠さず、参考原本は変更していない。元セル/色が変更0という前revisionの主張は転用していない。
73個の必須source支持対象は、実の一体化によって43個の機械検査対象部品へ完全対応する。全43支持・413荷重prefixは実CAD体積/重心と非reset root token台帳で検査し、最小公称margin1.009384090mm。単一solid・屋根・真の断面・接点・非干渉・挿入・全先行関係も検査した。旧Mona/body-support-v2の条件は緩めていない。
外部/仮組立支台は実0個。下側中央の実交互継ぎ目、同色の実根元一体化、完全内部の受け材料によって支持を修正した。内部色変更と一部下向き面の明示変更は差分と新mechanical baselineへ結合し、元の形/全色不変とは偽っていない。
実144frame/12fps/12秒/3章動画の1/18/54/73/108/144をデコード閲覧した。根元取付は実courseから選んだ76/77/78、114/115/116、134/135/136で確認した。最初のrootは真底面16.0mm、受けstage25.6mm/course6、step609であり、表示順のために実Zを変えていない。
保存sceneの全53,575instance/全native型・材質・pose/step、絶対放射復帰、frame73の本体0とframe144の全数復帰を独立照合した。実像を画像反転やCSSで置き換えていない。
既存のMona/Ducky、旧Copilot案/1x/FineC/native/CG/movie/URLは変更していない。実PLA/infill質量、保持力、クリープ、動的荷重、手のアクセス、スライサー支持材は未確認。外観の最終選択と印刷承認は保留。
observations_en: copilot-p300-symmetric-v3 contains53,575actual parts/306types, difference-44 from the fixed53,619target/17,873denominator. It is an additive intentionally corrected geometry/color revision, not an overwrite of the published case.

Every actual FreeCAD part has a complete color-preserving mirror-ID/pose bijection and involution. All272native type/rotation pairs have zero bidirectional BRep cut-volume difference. Original and relocated CAD match every ID/type/color/pose/step; this is not a cell-only or percentage-similarity pass.

All four real Blender views and matched native eye close-ups were inspected. Yellow eye outlines/dimensions/heights now match under reflection, as do blue face, goggle blue/purple regions and side/ear geometry. Oblique perspective and asymmetric illumination are reported separately from real shape or paint.

The saved native scene was also rendered as unlit material labels. Both eyes contain10,426pixels with77x148bounds at reflected positions. EyeXOR0/boundarydistance0/fullsilhouetteXOR0/fullmaterialXOR0. The declared one-pixel raster tolerance is not consumed: actual measured difference is zero.

Diagnosis traced the retained roughly0.903degree print-frame rotation and asymmetric Fine-C palette quantization transfer. True original painted triangles and their intrinsic bilateral plane guide the correction. Original1x/FineC residual asymmetry is disclosed, not silently rewritten; prior unchanged-cell/color assertions are not reused.

All73required source support targets are completely represented by43actual checked physical support parts after real unions. All43supports/413native mass-centroid load prefixes pass the non-resetting per-root token contract with minimum nominal margin1.009384090mm. Single solids, roofs, real sections, contacts, noninterference, insertion and predecessor ordering are verified without weakening old Mona/body-v2 guards.

There are zero actual external/temporary assembly aids. Alternating lower-body center bonds, same-color material unions and real internal receiving material fix the measured failures. Internal/explicit underside color transfers are bound to the new baseline and exact intentional-change record rather than falsely asserting unchanged original colors.

The actual144-frame/12fps/12-second/three-chapter MP4 was decoded at1/18/54/73/108/144 and actual support-course samples76-78,114-116,134-136. The first root retains physical bottomZ16.0mm and receivingstage25.6mm/course6 atstep609; physicalZ is not changed to fake ordering.

Saved-scene53575native instances/materials/poses/steps, absolute radial return, frame73empty and frame144complete coverage independently match the actual source. No image/CSS reflection substitutes for model changes.

Mona/Ducky and all old Copilot/reference/native/media/URLs remain untouched. Real PLA/infill mass, retention, creep, dynamic loads, hand access and slicer-support needs remain untested. User appearance selection and printing approval remain on hold.
